stylePrefix: Ultra-realistic cinematic photograph, shot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, authentic real-world scene, photorealistic people and objects, editorial commercial photography quality. Dark moody atmosphere with deep crimson #7A0A15 accent lighting, soft warm highlights, gentle rim light. Strictly no text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no captions, no on-screen readable text.

prompts.content-management-system: A real content marketing team working late in a modern editing studio: a wide wooden desk with three large monitors showing colorful social media grids and video timelines, a person's hands typing on a backlit keyboard, sticky notes and printed moodboards pinned on the brick wall behind, a warm desk lamp mixed with a deep crimson ambient glow. Realistic, lived-in, authentic.
prompts.marketing-sales-analytics-dashboard: A real marketing operations room at dusk: a professional standing with their back to camera facing a wall of large monitors glowing with clean line charts, bar graphs and a rising sales curve, a steaming coffee cup on the desk, cool blue and deep crimson screen light washing over the dark room, city lights glowing through the window behind. Cinematic and real.
prompts.ai-voice-agent-for-sales: A real Nigerian salesperson wearing a sleek wireless headset, speaking warmly on a call at a stylish modern desk, hand gesturing mid-conversation, smartphone and laptop beside them, soft crimson studio lighting with a shallow depth of field, genuine candid moment, photorealistic skin and fabric detail.
prompts.full-funnel-crm-lead-scoring-system: A real sales office wall with a large physical whiteboard covered in a hand-drawn lead pipeline: six colored marker stages drawn as a funnel with photo-pins of prospects, a sales rep's hand placing a bright red star marker onto the hottest lead at the final stage, realistic office lighting with a subtle crimson accent lamp.
prompts.paid-ads-to-crm-automation: A real advertising account manager's desk at night: a smartphone propped up showing a glowing social media ads feed and a laptop open to a clean customer relationship management grid, a thin stream of glowing crimson light particles flowing in a straight line between the two screens, dark modern office, photorealistic.
prompts.ai-content-research-generation-engine: A real content creator's studio desk in the morning: a laptop open beside stacked research books, printed articles and handwritten notes, a steaming mug of coffee, and four framed content formats on the wall behind the desk (a video studio, a podcast microphone, an article spread and a social media feed), warm window light with deep crimson accents, photorealistic and cozy.
prompts.ai-chatbot-for-lead-qualification: A real person sitting on a comfortable couch at night, smiling down at their smartphone while messaging, the phone screen glowing softly with a friendly chat conversation, cozy dark living room lit by a deep crimson ambient lamp, photorealistic hands and face, warm and inviting.
prompts.ghl-stripe-payment-automation: A real checkout moment in a stylish modern boutique: a customer's hand holding a sleek black payment card above a compact white contactless card reader on a stone counter, soft crimson mood lighting, blurred racks of clothes in the background, shallow depth of field, photorealistic texture detail.
prompts.learning-management-platform: A real student taking an online course at night at a wooden desk: a laptop open showing a clean course player interface with progress bars, a notebook and headphones beside it, a warm desk lamp and a deep crimson accent glow in the background, cozy focused study atmosphere, photorealistic.
prompts.ai-sdr-missed-revenue-recovery: A real sales representative at a busy desk reconnecting with a lost lead: a professional wireless headset in one hand, a smartphone glowing with an incoming call screen, an open notebook with a call-back list and a small framed calendar, hopeful crimson rim light across the scene, cinematic dark office, photorealistic.
